name: Astro-Rangers: Yellow – free low-poly sci-fi character
summary: Free low-poly sci-fi ranger character from ItsMudtip, in rigged and unrigged versions (.blend + .fbx) with a sniper rifle, swappable hands and pixel-art textures. Ready for game prototypes, animations or renders.

access.license: ItsMudtip EULA (commercial use with mandatory attribution)
access.notes: Personal and commercial use allowed; credit 'Astro Ranger - Yellow 3D Model by ItsMudtip' required; no resale/redistribution of the model or edits; no NFT or AI-training use (EULA in the zip).

procedure: Click Download Now, enter $0 (or tip) and choose 'No thanks, just take me to the downloads'.
Download YELLOW_Asset_Pack.zip (1.9 MB) and read README_License.txt inside.
Use RIGGED/Yellow_Rigged.fbx or .blend for animation, UNRRIGED/ for static use; textures are in TEXTURES/.

verdict.why: Real free download (zip fetched, EULA read), clean rigged + unrigged character usable commercially with credit. Single character and attribution/no-redistribution EULA keep it a small, niche entry.
